link_counts.title: I have System Commands oppe and college exam on same time
Request for OPPE Rescheduling Due to Family Wedding (System Commands – April 25)

posts.name: Aryan
posts.cooked:
Hi everyone,

I have a query regarding OPPE scheduling and would appreciate some guidance.

My OPPE 1 for the System Commands course is scheduled on 25th April (6–8 PM), but unfortunately, it clashes with my sister’s wedding on the same day, which is a very important family event for me.

I noticed that there is another opportunity to take the same OPPE on 2nd May. I wanted to ask—what would be the best place or process to formally request permission to take the OPPE on the alternate date? Should I raise a ticket, email support, or is there a specific form for such cases?

If anyone has faced a similar situation before, I’d really appreciate your guidance.

Thanks in advance!

posts.name: Aryan
posts.cooked: @sayan @Bharathi @pds_staff

posts.name: Aryan
posts.cooked:
Thank you for the clarification, sir.

I will email support at support@study.iitm.ac.in with the required details and proof for requesting postponement to the 2nd May slot.

Just to confirm, once the request is approved, I will be eligible to take the OPPE on 2nd May, correct?

Thanks again for the guidance.

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
aryangulia:

Just to confirm, once the request is approved, I will be eligible to take the OPPE on 2nd May, correct?

Yes, if your request is approved. If it is not, you will not be given a chance on 2nd May. But prepare well as it will be more difficult.

posts.name: Surya
posts.cooked:
I have System Commands oppe on 25th 5pm and I have my college end semester exam from 2-5pm on the same day.

I have filled a Googleform for rescheduling the oppe but there is no change in the date for the oppe in the mail I got today for attempting oppe.

I could not attempt it , and if I leave it now I will not get chance to reattempt on 2nd may. What to do?

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked: For such queries kindly mail support, as course teams do not handle OPPE scheduling.

posts.cooked: Ma’am, I am repeating SC course this term, but unfortunately I won’t be able to attend oppe today because of personal situation (family member passed away today). I want to know if repeat course student will also get a chance to repeat oppe next term like new course students if they get <40?

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
Sorry for your loss.

24f3004526:

I want to know if repeat course student will also have a repeat oppe next term like new course students?

Yes.
